coder_notes: Basket Phase 1-2; GBM in Dose Expansion GBM, Dose Expansion Recurrent Glioblastoma (surgical, delay surgery 2-4 weeks) and Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma (ST101 + temozolomide + radiation) arms. regimen = combination because the newly diagnosed arm adds TMZ/RT; recurrent GBM arms are ST101 monotherapy. Target engagement coded yes from stated PD objective plus mandatory pre- and on-treatment biopsy; tissue PD markers are not specified. PK outcomes are plasma only; the surgical recurrent arm might allow tumour drug levels but none is stated. 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' in conditions and 'primary (de novo) GBM' without IDH requirement -> historical. BRAF mention concerns prior therapy in melanoma only, not a selection biomarker.
